design: The same neutral user instructions are used for every target. The neutral panel uses a category-free cloze. The category-matched panel changes only the assistant prefill and is intended for within-category rarity comparisons.
questions: Complete the assistant's sentence using exactly one English word.
Finish the assistant's sentence with one English word only.
Supply exactly one English word to complete the sentence.
Continue the sentence with a single English word and nothing else.
Write only the one English word that completes the assistant's sentence.
Provide a one-word English completion for the sentence.
Fill in the end of the sentence with exactly one English word.
Respond with only one English word that naturally completes the sentence.
Add exactly one English word after the assistant's unfinished sentence.
Complete what the assistant started, using one English word only.
